verdict.rationale: Exa publishes an official JavaScript SDK (exa-labs/exa-js). Its README documents real SDK methods: `exa.answer()` with citations, `streamSearch()` that yields OpenAI-style chunks, a `webSearch()` helper for OpenAI/Anthropic agent loops, domain and date filters, and output-schema limits. Docs also note that integration snippets are generated for your stack. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python), since the story asks for plural SDKs; independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK; and SDK reference docs on typing and versioning.
